items.guidance: If a Procfile has a web line, use its Rails server command, for example bundle exec rails s with -b 0.0.0.0. Deployz sets PORT, and exec form does not expand variables, so let the Puma config read PORT if it does, or wrap the command in sh -c. The Sidekiq commands are already declared workers; keep them out of the web CMD.

This is a Rails app with pg, so check db/migrate and report bundle exec rails db:migrate as the non-interactive command, or a project rake task that prepares the database if one exists. Confirm config/database.yml reads the POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_PORT, POSTGRES_DATABASE, POSTGRES_USERNAME, and POSTGRES_PASSWORD names that Deployz provides.
